title: parley query
description: A read against the history, recorded as an event: the asker it is for, the view it wants, the budget it will accept and the window it covers (spec §9, informative; the representation is decided in flyingrobots/parley#46 and read against the observer-geometry treatment in docs/topics/related-work/observer-geometry.md). The envelope's run is the read's own run; asker is who the read is for. A drill-down, which opens records a lens named, is the same message with records stating which.

run.description: The execution this line belongs to: the read itself, not the runs being read (spec §2.1).

session.description: Working period spanning runs. Supplied by the caller or inherited; never invented (spec §2.1).

tool.description: The calling program, named as in spec §2.1. Established from the caller's own identity or supplied as one argument; never invented, so a read that cannot establish it is refused.

cwd.description: Absolute POSIX working directory the read was made from. Inferred from the process; omitted when it is not meaningful.

task.description: The caller's current task id, supplied by the caller and never inferred (flyingrobots/parley#61); omitted when the caller does not state it. Not the session: a session is a working period, a task is a unit of work inside one.

asker.description: Who the read is for, and the context the budget is inferred from. The asker is not the view: two askers requesting the same view under the same budget get the same answer.

view.description: The shape of the answer, one token from a closed set. Never inferred: there is no privileged view, so a missing view is refused rather than guessed. Adding a token is a version of this schema.

records.description: The most records the answer may name. Required: a view with no bound collapses into "return every record".

bytes.description: The most bytes the answer may occupy.

ms.description: The most wall-clock milliseconds the read may spend.

budget.description: The size of answer the asker will accept. One documented default applies when it is not supplied, and the applied budget is carried verbatim by the result's lens, so a default is never invisible.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound of the window, POSIX time in milliseconds. 0 means "from the start of the history".

to.description: Inclusive upper bound of the window, POSIX time in milliseconds. Never below from.

window.description: The stretch of history the read covers, always stated as two timestamps and echoed by the result's lens.

note.description: Free text from the asker, recorded and never parsed. Nothing in the answer branches on it.

fold.description: Whether the read may fold runs it judges to be repeats of one invocation with one result into the most recent of them (flyingrobots/parley#79). false: nothing is folded, so every run in the window keeps its own records and the budget alone decides what the answer names (flyingrobots/parley#133). true or absent: the reader folds, and the result's lens names the runs a fold stands for in the section of the run that stands for them (parley.lens runs.folded.stands_for). The budget can leave that run out of the answer, and its section with it; the lens then reports that fold as a count alone (parley.lens loss.folded). Never inferred: the reader records it only when the asker states it, and the lens echoes it. It selects nothing on a drill-down.

seq.description: 0 for a bootstrap or startup-failure line (spec §1.3).

records.description: Present only on a drill-down: the records the read asks for by (run, seq), the identity a parley.lens names them by, in the order asked (flyingrobots/parley#51). A drill-down answers with exactly these records in full, a sidecar's stored record included, and an outcome per id; the view and window are recorded and select nothing, budget.records is the number of ids asked, and budget.bytes, when stated, bounds the records opened: whole records in the order asked while their summed size stays within it, and an over_budget outcome with no contents for each id past it (flyingrobots/parley#78). Absent on a read that answers with a digest.

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (spec §4.5, §4.6).
